raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stacked on #45556 (admit the DeepSeek-V4 paged KV layout in the PD decode radix cache). Review only the top two commits.

## Motivation

On a PD decode server with `--disaggregation-decode-enable-radix-cache`, decode matches the prompt against its tree but never reuses tree SWA. It caps the match at `fill - swa_tail_len`, releases the SWA lock, and allocates a fresh SWA tail that prefill always transfers. Paged SWA still gates that match, though. A boundary counts only if a full window of live tree SWA sits before it. Decode evicts SWA behind its window while decoding, so a match capped in the middle of a node finds no live window and falls back to 0.

DeepSeek-V4.1 example (page 256):
- A finished turn leaves a `[0, 3840)` node. A follow-up whose cap lands on 3840 hits 3840, but only because the page `[3584, 3840)` was allocated for the SWA tail and holds live (never written) rows.
- A follow-up 18 tokens shorter caps at 3584 and gets no decode-local hit at all.

## Modifications

- `swa_gates_tree_prefix_match` (`kv_cache_builder.py`) now also turns SWA gating off on a PD decode that re-transfers its SWA tail. It joins the per-request ring and the encoder-replay request window, which already turn it off for the same reason: the tree does not own that SWA.
- `uses_swa_tail_prealloc` is the decode queue's existing predicate, moved next to it so both read one definition. Page-size-1 SWA decode, which does not re-transfer the tail, still gates.

## Tests

- `test_swa_gates_tree_prefix_match.py`: decode with SWA tail prealloc (SWA and DeepSeek-V4 pools) does not gate; prefill, colocated, page size 1 and pools without tail prealloc still gate. The decode case fails with the change reverted.
- Existing decode unit suites pass: `test_decode_queue_cleanup`, `test_decode_radix_lock_ref`, `test_decode_radix_cache_validation`, `test_prefill_complete_integration`, `test_hisparse_allocator`.
- `test_disaggregation_decode_radix_cache_swa` (gpt-oss-20b, decode radix, run over Mooncake locally): passes before and after.

  | | before | after |
  |---|---|---|
  | gsm8k first / second pass | 0.884 / 0.878 | 0.89 / 0.874 |
  | multi-turn hit rate | 0.5385 | 0.5385 |

- New e2e `test_disaggregation_decode_radix_cache_dsv41.py` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 1P1D, DEP2 each, DSpark, decode radix cache): three 3K-token lookup tables, nine lookups each, prefill flushed before every lookup so `cached_tokens` is decode-local. Every follow-up lookup must hit at least the page-aligned table minus two pages, and at least 90% of lookups must be answered correctly. It fails with this fix reverted (0 < 2304).

  | | before | after |
  |---|---|---|
  | decode-local hit, 3K-token table | 0 | 2560 / 2560 / 2816 |

  With the fix, all 27 lookups were correct in each of four runs.

+"""DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash PD decode radix cache on the paged KV layout.
+
+Prefill is flushed before every lookup, so `cached_tokens` is the decode-local hit.
+"""
+
+import json
+import random
+import unittest
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.benchmark.utils import get_tokenizer
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.disaggregation_fixture import (
+    PDDisaggregationServerBase,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import try_cached_model
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=900, stage="base-c", runner_config="4-gpu-gb300")
+
+MODEL = "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash"
+PAGE_SIZE = 256
+LAUNCH_TIMEOUT = 1800
+NUM_LOOKUPS = 8
+
+SERVER_ARGS = [
+    "--dp-size",
+    "2",
+    "--ep-size",
+    "2",
+    "--enable-dp-attention",
+    "--enable-dp-lm-head",
+    "--moe-a2a-backend",
+    "megamoe",
+    "--dsv4-attn-backend",
+    "flashmla",
+    "--mem-fraction-static",
+    "0.85",
+    "--speculative-algorithm",
+    "DSPARK",
+    "--speculative-dspark-block-size",
+    "5",
+    "--model-loader-extra-config",
+    json.dumps({"enable_multithread_load": True}),
+    "--weight-loader-prefetch-checkpoints",
+    "--enable-cache-report",
+]
+SERVER_ENV = {
+    "SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_FORCE_QUERY_PREFILL_DP_RANK": "1",
+    "SGLANG_ENABLE_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE": "1",
+    "SGLANG_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE_LAYOUT": "per_rank",
+}
+PREFILL_ENV = {
+    "SGLANG_ENABLE_PREFILL_WAR_READ_DONE": "1",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK": "32768",
+    "SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL": "1",
+}
+DECODE_ENV = {"SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK": "16384"}
+
+
+class TestDisaggregationDecodeRadixCacheDSV41(PDDisaggregationServerBase):
+    prefill_tp_size = 2
+    decode_tp_size = 2
+    decode_base_gpu_id = 2
+    extra_prefill_args = [*SERVER_ARGS, "--chunked-prefill-size", "65536"]
+    extra_decode_args = [
+        *SERVER_ARGS,
+        "--disaggregation-decode-enable-radix-cache",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode",
+        "24",
+    ]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        cls.model = try_cached_model(MODEL)
+        cls.tokenizer = get_tokenizer(cls.model)
+        cls.extra_prefill_env = {**SERVER_ENV, **PREFILL_ENV}
+        cls.extra_decode_env = {**SERVER_ENV, **DECODE_ENV}
+        cls.launch_all()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def wait_server_ready(cls, url, timeout=LAUNCH_TIMEOUT, process=None):
+        super().wait_server_ready(
+            url, timeout=max(timeout, LAUNCH_TIMEOUT), process=process
+        )
+
+    def _generate(self, input_ids):
+        response = requests.post(
+            f"{self.base_url}/generate",
+            json={
+                "input_ids": input_ids,
+                "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0.0, "max_new_tokens": 8},
+                "routed_dp_rank": 0,
+            },
+            timeout=300,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
+    def _encode(self, text):
+        return self.tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
+
+    def _build_table(self, rng, num_rows):
+        rows = {
+            f"key-{i:04d}": str(rng.randrange(10**5, 10**6)) for i in range(num_rows)
+        }
+        text = "".join(f"{key}: {value}\n" for key, value in rows.items())
+        return rows, self._encode(f"Lookup table:\n{text}")
+
+    def test_decode_local_prefix_hit_keeps_lookups_correct(self):
+        rng = random.Random(0)
+        num_correct = num_total = 0
+        for num_rows in (330, 340, 350):
+            rows, table_ids = self._build_table(rng, num_rows)
+            keys = rng.sample(sorted(rows), NUM_LOOKUPS + 1)
+            min_hit = len(table_ids) // PAGE_SIZE * PAGE_SIZE - 2 * PAGE_SIZE
+            for lookup_idx, key in enumerate(keys):
+                requests.post(
+                    f"{self.prefill_url}/flush_cache?timeout=60", timeout=90
+                ).raise_for_status()
+                output = self._generate(table_ids + self._encode(f"\n{key}:"))
+                if lookup_idx > 0:
+                    self.assertGreaterEqual(
+                        output["meta_info"]["cached_tokens"], min_hit
+                    )
+                num_correct += output["text"].split()[0] == rows[key]
+                num_total += 1
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(num_correct, 0.9 * num_total)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""PD decode re-transfers the SWA tail, so tree SWA must not gate its prefix match."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.deepseek_v4_memory_pool import DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_cache_builder import swa_gates_tree_prefix_match
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.swa_memory_pool import SWAKVPool
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _pool(cls, **attrs):
+    pool = cls.__new__(cls)
+    for name, value in attrs.items():
+        setattr(pool, name, value)
+    return pool
+
+
+def _allocator(page_size, tail_prealloc=True):
+    allocator = SimpleNamespace(page_size=page_size)
+    if tail_prealloc:
+        allocator.alloc_extend_swa_tail = lambda *args: None
+    return allocator
+
+
+class TestSwaGatesTreePrefixMatch(CustomTestCase):
+    def _gates(self, mode, pool, allocator):
+        with get_context().override_server_args(disaggregation_mode=mode):
+            return swa_gates_tree_prefix_match(pool, allocator)
+
+    def test_decode_with_swa_tail_prealloc_does_not_gate(self):
+        for pool in (
+            _pool(SWAKVPool),
+            _pool(DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool, request_window=None),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(pool=type(pool).__name__):
+                self.assertFalse(self._gates("decode", pool, _allocator(256)))
+
+    def test_prefill_and_colocated_still_gate(self):
+        for mode in ("prefill", "null"):
+            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
+                self.assertTrue(self._gates(mode, _pool(SWAKVPool), _allocator(256)))
+
+    def test_decode_without_swa_tail_prealloc_still_gates(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._gates("decode", _pool(SWAKVPool), _allocator(1)))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            self._gates("decode", _pool(SWAKVPool), _allocator(64, tail_prealloc=False))
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
